title: Activity logging: ModelActivityMixin vs explicit log_activity
answers: How do I add activity logging to a model?
Why is my bulk update not in the activity log?
body:
- `ModelActivityMixin` (posthog/models/activity_logging/model_activity.py) sends a signal on `save()` for creates/updates; the scope is the class name. Set `activity_logging_on_delete = True` to log deletes.
- Writes that bypass `save()` (e.g. `QuerySet.update`, `bulk_create`) are not seen by the signal. This is from the agent's summary, not verified in code. Call `log_activity` (posthog/models/activity_logging/activity_log.py) explicitly.
- `changes_between` builds diffs. `ImpersonatedContext` (model_activity.py) covers impersonation.
applies: Models that inherit ModelActivityMixin; other models need explicit log_activity calls.
